description: This file implements the file write infrastructure for SHA1-summed files in a version control system, providing functions for verifying, flushing, finalizing, and discarding hash-based files, as well as handling hash calculations and checkpoints.

methods.name: void verify_buffer_or_die(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Verifies that the buffer read from the check file matches the provided buffer, aborting on error.

methods.name: void flush(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the file, verifying the buffer if in check mode, and updates throughput display.

methods.name: void hashflush(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Flushes the current hashfile's buffer, finalizing the hash if needed.

methods.name: void free_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the hashfile structure and its buffers.

methods.name: int finalize_hashfile(struct hashfile * f,unsigned char * result,enum fsync_component component,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Finalizes the hash calculation, writes it to the result buffer, flushes, syncs, closes and cleans up the hashfile.

methods.name: void discard_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Closes and frees resources associated with the hashfile without finalizing.

methods.name: void hashwrite(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes data to the hashfile, updating hash and possibly flushing buffers.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_check(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with a check file for verification.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_internal(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp,size_t buffer_len)
methods.description: Helper function to initialize a hashfile, with specified buffer and progress meter handling.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with a default large buffer for general use.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_throughput(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with a smaller buffer suitable for progress reporting.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint_init(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Initializes a checkpoint for a hashfile.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint of the current hashfile state.

methods.name: int hashfile_truncate(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Truncates a hashfile to a checkpoint position.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_end(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Finalizes CRC32 checksum and returns the result.

methods.name: int hashfile_checksum_valid(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const unsigned char * data,size_t total_len)
methods.description: Verifies if the checksum in a data buffer is valid.
